main.summary: Immutable SHA-512 fingerprint of a complete serialized access-key credential used to identify its cached membership.

field.name: part1
field.summary: First 128-bit segment of the credential fingerprint.

field.name: part2
field.summary: Second 128-bit segment of the credential fingerprint.

field.name: part3
field.summary: Third 128-bit segment of the credential fingerprint.

field.name: part4
field.summary: Fourth 128-bit segment of the credential fingerprint.

constructor.name: ConstructorDigest
constructor.summary: Create a membership-cache key from an already-computed SHA-512 credential fingerprint.
constructor.param: SHA-512 digest of the complete serialized credential.

method.name: TryCreate
method.summary: Try to create a membership-cache key by hashing the complete serialized access-key credential with SHA-512.
method.returns: True if the key was derived successfully; otherwise false.

method.name: Equals
method.summary: Determine equality with another derived membership cache key.

method.name: op_Equality
method.summary: Determine whether two derived membership cache keys are equal.

method.name: op_Inequality
method.summary: Determine whether two derived membership cache keys are not equal.
method.returns: True if not equal; otherwise false.
